Final review complete; no further changes required.

Change (src/dotenv/parser.py, line 30 only):
`_rest_of_line` alternation reordered from `(?:\r|\n|\r\n)?` to `(?:\r\n|\r|\n)?`.

Effect: the error-recovery path in `parse_binding` now consumes a CRLF as one complete newline, so an invalid line's `original.string` includes the full `\r\n` and the following valid binding starts at line 2 with `original.string` exactly `GOOD=ok` plus its newline. LF and lone CR still consume exactly one terminator, and repeated invalid lines each consume exactly one line terminator, so those behaviors are preserved. The ordering now matches the existing `_newline` and `_end_of_line` patterns.

Scope: only src/dotenv/parser.py was edited; tests, docs, other modules, and dependencies are untouched. Host acceptance and selected upstream regression tests passed.

Remaining limitations: none known. The fix is confined to the recovery path; no other parser semantics were altered.
